library(tmap)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

miss_river <- st_read("data/MajorRivers.shp")

Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: -164.8874 ymin: -36.96945 xmax: 160.7636 ymax: 71.39249
Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84

mississippi <- miss_river %>%
  filter(NAME == "Mississippi")  # double check this with `unique(miss_river$NAME)` if needed

counties <- counties(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m", year = 2022)

cities_df <- read_csv("data/uscities copy.csv")

Rows: 31254 Columns: 17
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr (9): city, city_ascii, state_id, state_name, county_fips, county_name, s...
dbl (6): lat, lng, population, density, ranking, id
lgl (2): military, incorporated

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.

cities <- st_as_sf(cities_df, coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326)

cities <- st_transform(cities, crs = st_crs(mississippi))


counties <- st_transform(counties, crs = st_crs(mississippi))

counties_miss <- counties[st_intersects(counties, mississippi, sparse = FALSE), ]

cities_in_miss <- st_join(cities, counties_miss, join = st_within)

cities_in_miss <- cities_in_miss %>% filter(!is.na(NAME))  # `NAME` is a county field

county_pop <- cities_in_miss %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(STATEFP, COUNTYFP) %>%
  summarise(total_urban_pop = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE))

`summarise()` has grouped output by 'STATEFP'. You can override using the
`.groups` argument.



counties_final <- counties_miss %>%
  left_join(county_pop, by = c("STATEFP", "COUNTYFP"))

tmap_mode("plot")

ℹ tmap mode set to "plot".

tm_shape(counties_final) +
  tm_polygons("total_urban_pop", palette = "Blues", title = "Urban Population") +
  tm_layout(title = "Urban Population in Counties Along the Mississippi River")
